timeline.title: Red Deer engagement identifies cultural-safety concerns
timeline.short_description: Participants raised cultural safety, racism and bias as health-system concerns; this was consultation evidence, not a formal case finding.
timeline.organization: Government of Alberta and Alberta Health Services

timeline.title: Indigenous advisory panel convened
timeline.short_description: Indigenous leaders and health-system participants developed recommendations for primary health-care reform.

timeline.title: Panel issues 22 recommendations
timeline.short_description: The final report organizes recommendations around culturally safe, Indigenous-led and accountable care.
timeline.organization: Indigenous Primary Health Care Advisory Panel

timeline.title: Early investment opportunities published
timeline.short_description: Government identifies early commitments and implementation mechanisms.

timeline.title: The Way Forward published
timeline.short_description: A separate Indigenous primary-health-care plan sets out implementation work.

timeline.title: Funding and oversight mechanisms operate
timeline.short_description: Navigator grants, an innovation fund, an Indigenous Health Division and patient-safety advocate are publicly documented.
timeline.organization: Government of Alberta / Office of Alberta Health Advocates

timeline.title: Anti-racism engagement held
timeline.short_description: Government gathered input and reported that results were under review; a final resulting strategy was not located.
